whatIs: Park UI is a set of carefully designed components built on Ark UI (behavior and accessibility) and Panda CSS (styles). The idea is that you use them as a base for building your own design system. It works with React and Solid, and the project has become part of the Chakra UI organization.
It's a good fit when you want ready-made components but with control over styles and design tokens, and you already use Panda CSS or are willing to.
uses: Building a company's design system from ready-made accessible components.
Changing the accent color across the whole interface without rewriting styles.
Building sign-up, payment or notification forms with components that are consistent with each other.
caveats: It depends on Panda CSS, so your project needs that styling tool.
It only offers React and Solid versions; if you work with Vue or Svelte, it's no use to you.
It's a smaller project than other component libraries; check the changelog to see how often it changes.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: Teams that want to build their own design system on Panda CSS.
